device: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Engineering Reference Developer Kit Super
clock_note: Post-reboot balanced A-B-B-A-A-B diagnostic. GPU DVFS remained unlocked at 306-1020 MHz, so these are candidate results rather than locked-clock release numbers.

candidate_composition.description: Conservative hybrid bundles: 13 engines use fixed min=opt=max shapes for the visible resolution; p_synthesis.plan is the validated dynamic plan from the 720p bundle.
candidate_composition.reason: The host model directory contained a stale p_synthesis.onnx whose SHA-256 did not match the pinned v2 model manifest. Static p_synthesis plans were quarantined and excluded rather than reporting untraceable results.

runtime_change.description: Allow TensorRT axes declared runtime-variable by NVCR to be either dynamic (-1) or a valid positive fixed dimension, and preserve fixed input dimensions during load-time warm-up.
runtime_change.compatibility: Dynamic profiles retain their previous -1 validation and warm-up shapes; fixed batch/channel axes remain exact. No CUDA architecture branch, model, weight, entropy, or bitstream-format change was introduced.

post_measurement_stabilization.artifact_status: The measured 13-fixed-plus-1-dynamic bundles are historical diagnostic evidence only. The final validator and runtime reject them as incomplete fixed bundles.
post_measurement_stabilization.shape_contract: Legacy and declared-dynamic bundles require -1 on runtime-variable axes. Declared-fixed bundles require positive concrete dimensions on every runtime-variable axis in all 14 plans.
post_measurement_stabilization.profile_contract: Manifest identity, visible dimensions, workspace, builder level, and shape mode are derived from and checked against the selected versioned engine profile.

correctness.note: Different TensorRT tactics produce deterministic but non-bit-exact FP16 streams. Candidate quality is not lower.

verification.model_build_guard: rejected the invalid local export before producing a TensorRT plan
verification.dynamic_profile_regression: the 720p-fp16 bundle completed every baseline encode/decode run and the final hardened-runtime roundtrip
verification.hybrid_rejection: the measured 360p hybrid fails artifact validation and runtime initialization under the final contract
verification.portable_build: TensorRT-disabled clean build passed 4/4 registered tests
verification.clean_package_probe: Orin SM 8.7 Release build/install/package passed and contained both edge profiles plus hardened artifact helpers

decision: Keep both versioned profile definitions and fixed-profile runtime support. The 360p and 540p measurements are useful performance signals, but no hybrid engine bundle is accepted for distribution. Treat 540p decode as experimental until a fully fixed, locked-clock repetition clears the threshold.
next_action: Restore the pinned PyTorch/ONNX exporter environment, regenerate the canonical p_synthesis.onnx bundle, rebuild fully fixed 360p/540p plans, and repeat under locked clocks.
